Class TelemetryAnalyticsPlugin

java.lang.Object
bluej.extensions2.Extension
comp3607project.TelemetryAnalyticsPlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener, bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener, bluej.extensions2.event.InvocationFinishedListener, bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener
public class TelemetryAnalyticsPlugin extends bluej.extensions2.Extension implements bluej.extensions2.event.PackageListener, bluej.extensions2.event.CompileListener, bluej.extensions2.event.InvocationFinishedListener, bluej.extensions2.event.ClassListener
BlueJ extension entry point that registers IDE listeners, records package, compilation, invocation and class events, and exports reports when a session finishes.

This documentation is generated from a separate copy of the submitted source. The original project source files are not modified.
